messages:
sara: Starting deploy for routing v3. Need a feature-flag rollout plan for multiregion. Targets: eu-west, us-west, ap-sg. Intend to pin model=redwood-v3-small for the first 10m. Any objections?

devops-bot: Deploy triggered: canary on cluster-a (build 2026.03.20-73). Canary slice = 1% traffic. CI checks running.

matt: @sara +1. Proposed FF matrix (minute increments):
- eu-west: 2% -> 10% -> 25%
- us-west: 1% -> 5% -> 20%
- ap-sg: 0.5% -> 5% -> hold at 10% (extra vetting)
Steps = 5m; watch p95, errors, and token-cost variance. Keep model pinned for 15m after first shift.

olivia: Slow the ap-sg ramp. We saw latency spikes at low % last time (cold KV cache). Recommend initial holdback to 5% for cache warmup and explicit kill-switch in the runbook. :warning:

lee: Rollback criteria to codify in the runbook: errors > 0.7% OR avg latency > 250ms sustained over 3m -> flip flag off, pin to redwood-v2 variant, drain connections, notify oncall. Also ensure we don't trigger auto-scale churn.

matt: Toggle snippet for ops (use internal FF API):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://ff.internal.redwood/api/v1/toggles" 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"flag":"routing_v3","env":"eu-west","pct":10,"meta":{"pin_model":"redwood-v3-small","initiator":"sara"}}'
```
And the rollout matrix we will apply as JSON:```json
{"routing_v3": {"eu-west": [2,10,25], "us-west": [1,5,20], "ap-sg": [0.5,5,10], "step_minutes": 5}}
```

qa-bot: Canary test summary: semantic smoke 132/133 ok, rerank smoke failed 1 (timing). Added extra logging on rerank path and re-ran golden prompt set. No model quality regressions detected apart from the timing flake.

devops-bot: Canary metrics update: 1% traffic -> p50 200ms, p95 420ms, errors 0.2%. No alert thresholds tripped.

olivia: @matt also add FF metadata to pin model_version explicitly so the flag change swaps routing logic only, not model binary. That avoids rollout-time model swaps.

sara: Plan ack. I'll start eu-west at 2% at 22:14 UTC, then follow the matrix. If any rollback criteria hit I'll flip flag to 0 and post into #incidents. I'll leave the model pinned for 15m after first increment. :thumbsup:

lee: Oncall standby. If kill-switch triggers I'll run the drain/rollback helper: `./scripts/rollback_routing.sh eu-west` and follow the checklist (drain -> re-pin v2 -> confirm traffic back).

devops-bot: Rollout started by sara at 2298765432. Canary watch active.
